title: Limatus
description:
# Limatus

Standalone editorial quality tool: diagnose slop-like weakness, propose constrained rewrite options (markup / redline-style suggestions), human-steered apply with diffs. Quality-first — **not** detector-score evasion.

## Intent

Spin the automated editorial loop out of Papyrus into **Limatus**, a clean isolated package (CLI + Python SDK) with its own local style-rules config. Planning and early milestones live on the Papyrus board until the Limatus repo/package is cut.

## Guardrail

Quality outcomes, not detector-score gaming. North-star: human acceptance after factual review.

## What already exists

Epic `PPY-54055d` — interactive editorial rewrite loop (diagnose → options → steer/apply/provenance), currently in-tree under `papyrus_content`. Style profile + diagnostic JSON closed; rewrite options / verifier / steer-apply remain open.

## Milestones

1. **In-Papyrus MVP loop** (`PPY-54055d`) — finish interactive loop while still in-tree.
2. **Decouple into Limatus** (`PPY-639fb3`) — portable CLI + Python SDK; local style-rules config; no Papyrus imports.
3. **Evaluations** (`PPY-89827a`) — harness for diagnose + rewrite-option quality.
4. **Papyrus consumes Limatus via SDK** (`PPY-b536c2`) — newsroom / Tactus procedures call Limatus; in-tree core removed or shimmed.

## Non-goals

- Detector-gaming “humanizer” products.
- Auto-publishing externally attributable copy without a human gate.
